newsitem.title: INDIA: India to get 135 bln yen development Japanese loan.
newsitem.headline: India to get 135 bln yen development Japanese loan.

text.p: Japan will provide a 135 billion yen official development assistance (ODA) loan to India in fiscal 1996/97 (April-March), a government statement said on Wednesday.
"The government of Japan has indicated a package of Yen 135 billion as official development assistance to India during 1996/97," the statement said.
It said the ODA loan will be used for 11 developmental projects, including thermal power, mass rapid transit system, hydroelectric power, transport infrastructure and canal irrigation projects.
